description: Verify that Server-side reboot detection — duplicate SD session_id triggers expire_subscriptions
approach:
[Objective]
When DUT detects a duplicate (or non-incrementing) session_id from the peer, it must expire prior subscriptions to prevent stale event delivery.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. DUT → Tester: OfferService with endpoint.
2. Subscribe → Ack.
3. Tester triggers events post-subscribe → DUT emits.
4. Tester sends FindService.
5. Tester triggers more events.
6. Tester sends reboot signal.
7. Observation: DUT must NOT emit further events after reboot signal.

[Pass condition]
Observed DUT behaviour matches the spec property.

[Fail condition]
Per-phase Fail_phase<n>_* per the verdict list.

verdicts.Pass: DUT expired subscriptions on reboot — normal
verdicts.Fail_phase1_no_offer_with_endpoint: No OfferService with IPv4 endpoint within listen window
verdicts.Fail_phase6_event_post_reboot: Test event observed after simulated reboot
